title: M/s Janki News Print Ltd. v. Pashchimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.
coram: Saral Srivastava, J.; Sudhanshu Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed for alternative remedy; s.111 appeal if filed in one month to be heard on merits, limitation not to be gone into.
headnote: Mandamus for refund of system loading charges and a declaration that Clauses 4.6(h)(i) and 4.21(a) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 are ultra vires is refused. Following dismissal of an identical writ, the petition is dismissed for alternative remedy, with liberty to appeal under Section 111 of the Electricity Act, 2003 within one month; that appeal is to be decided on merits without examining limitation.
facts: M/s Janki News Print Ltd. sought mandamus directing Pashchimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd. to refund Rs 36,82,000 realised as system loading charges, with interest, and to declare Clauses 4.6(h)(i) and 4.21(a) of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 ultra vires Sections 42(1), 43 and 46 of the Electricity Act, 2003 read with Clause 4.2 of the Code. An identical writ (Writ-C No. 67768 of 2009) had been dismissed on 5 January 2026 for alternative remedy.

holding_units.holding: Following dismissal of identical Writ-C No. 67768 of 2009, the writ seeking refund of system loading charges and vires of Supply Code cls. 4.6(h)(i) and 4.21(a) is dismissed on alternative remedy. If the petitioner files an appeal under s.111 EA 2003 before the Appellate Authority within one month, that authority shall decide it on merits without entering into limitation.

not_decided.point: vires of cls. 4.6(h)(i) and 4.21(a) UP-2005 (system loading charges vis-à-vis ss. 42(1), 43, 46 EA 2003 and cl. 4.2)
not_decided.note: Dismissed on alternative remedy without examining the challenge.

not_decided.point: refund of Rs 36,82,000 system loading charges with interest
